svg.text: Shared Capacity Load Formula, Overload Confirmation Protocol & What-If Simulator
Mathematical models implemented identically in CapacityService, BottleneckService, and SimulatorService across both backends
Shared Monthly Load % Formula (CapacityService.js)
Load % = ( (Traction Plan / Traction Cap) + (DCS Plan / DCS Cap) ) x 100
Base Monthly Capacities (100% shared ceiling per entity):
* PDR Mechanical (4 workers): 10 Traction OR 30 DCS / month (e.g., 5T + 15D = 100%)
* HV Cabling (PDR 1-5 & CRM 1-9 = 14 teams): 3 Traction OR 5 DCS / month (assumed)
* LV Wiring Primary (PDR Team 6): 26 Traction / month (1/day x 26 days) OR 5 DCS / month
KSM Stage 1 & Sub-Assemblies: Tracked via Daily Targets only (no monthly Load %)
Overload Gate (HTTP 409) & Bottleneck Detection
HTTP 409 Overload Gate (PlanTargets & StartStageModal):
When new assignment or plan pushes Load % >= 100% (start) or > 100% (plan)
without confirmedOverload=true -> HTTP 409 asks operator confirmation before saving
Automated Bottleneck Engine (BottleneckService.js):
Flags stage when queueDepth >= max(2, 2 x avgQueueDepth)
OR avgDwellHours >= max(4, 2 x overallAvgDwell) -> suggests team reallocation
Isolated What-If Capacity Simulator Solver (SimulatorService.js)
Inputs: Monthly Traction Target, DCS Target, Working Days (1-31), Overtime Hours (0-8h), Extra Mech Workers, Extra Elec Teams, Extra Shifts (0-2)
Effective Hours Multiplier: M = 1 + (overtimeHours / 8) + extraShifts
Evaluates 5 Simultaneous Capacity Constraints across entire factory:
1. PDR Mechanical | 2. HV Cabling Teams | 3. LV Wiring (Primary + 3 Overflow Teams x 3) | 4. KSM Stage 1 | 5. KSM DCS Doors
Feasibility Output: Computes alpha = min(alpha_i) across binding constraints, Proportional / Priority feasible output (T_feas, D_feas),
shortfall, overloaded constraints, advisory material note (unblocking), and stores comparison snapshots only in what_if_scenarios
